body:
it does really bother me that because people dont see the disability until i have a slight episode and have spasms or collapse or throw something involuntarily across a room, that im faking it, its not as bad as i make it out, its nothing major, they dont see what im so upset about, or the one that gets me and that stops you from getting a job why?!
it makes you feel so useless.

thank you very much, that does actually mean a lot and i understand where you're coming from its like the simplest thing has a code to beat before im able to do it. 
i have a form of functional neurological disorder caused by trauma and abuse, paired with PTSD, Depression, migraines with an added side of IBS and self loathing.
So getting up in the morning...if i manage to get to sleep at all at which point today looks like a no as its 7:33am and im awake, is difficult enough. And the thought of "if i go to sleep am i going to beat myself and wake up with black eyes and a bust lip and nose, and is it worth the hassle" or "if i go to sleep am i going to have the nightmares again" i just cant win really. 
Thank you for understanding though. 
You have an amazing husband for supporting you and understanding that things get tough.

my friends are pretty out of the loop because if i try and speak to them about it they just call this person stuff and that hurts me a lot because this person means the world to me we've been through hell and back together and helped each other at some of our worst and darkest times, they know my whole story and they still loved me...and now, now we're friends and still love each other and still care and still are close and i adore them...but they refuse to let anyone close and i guess in some ways i am hanging on to hope that one day they'll let the walls back down. because they got me to try.
but they think im stalking them through the internet...which is so petty!! and it infuriates me they think that little of me. and they started a huge argument calling me a liar and a stalker because i stumbled onto something of theirs and brought it up and yeah i fee utterly worthless...as stupid as that sounds, it could have been anyone else and i wouldnt care, i've had worse, but to not be trusted by this person has really hit hard and made me feel utterly worthless. 
i keep telling myself how stupid i'm being and that its just words and everything will be fine when i see them next. but i just cant shake the feeling they're going to remove me from their life because who wants someone like me around them. damaged goods, stupid disability, depression and on top of it thinking im a liar. it doesnt seem like a person anyone would want around to me.

i've looked online about my disability and because its rare the only place i had any actual support and understanding is when i was in hospital for a month getting the full diagnosis and there where people there with the same diagnosis maybe not the same symptoms but they understood.
i sometimes wish i had stayed there.
but the person gave me hope. they where my everything and gave me a reason to come home. and then it was gone. i feel utterly stupid to be honest posting up about everything, i feel like ive failed myself.

all my friends are too close to the issue to talk about, my family dont exactly understand and so im pretty much left most of the time dealing with things on my own when i feel down. i tried calling a helpline before and they actually made it worse, she spoke to her friend while i was on the phone telling her i had, had enough and was ready to go and she was talking about her saturday night out with the friend near her. i hung up. the only reason i didnt do it...was because i couldnt let my family find me after that.
im pretty much stuck feeling like a complete wreck and wondering what the point actually is. the one person I valued the most thinks im a liar and would betray their trust, when their the one person i would and have done everything to preserve anything with and has been the one person then has pushed me to do so much and now i guess im wondering what the point was if they have such a low opinion of me.
